name: japan-jepx-mcp
title: Japan JEPX Electricity Spot Price MCP
description: MCP server — Japan wholesale electricity spot prices (JEPX). System + 9 area prices (Hokkaido, Tohoku, Tokyo, Chubu, Hokuriku, Kinki, Chugoku, Shikoku, Kyushu) at 30-min granularity (48 periods/day), JPY/kWh. Latest price, full-day curve, daily-average history, cheapest slots/areas.

input.title: Actor input schema
input.description: MCP server runs in Standby mode — input happens via MCP tool calls, not Actor input.
